svg.aria-label: The world maker: a chart of which rule combinations are for training and which are held out for testing, next to four generated levels
svg.text: Endless new levels, each built from a seed and checked by the solver. Some rules never appear in training.
training (13 kinds of world, mazes included)
one rule on its own; other squares mix two
Training never shows coins, or crates with gates, keys with ice or gates with twin. Held-out lifetimes always do.
